_comment: Project-scoped MCP allowlist. Every server here passes the CLAUDE.md §3.8 license check (MIT or Apache-2.0). Credentials are injected via env vars at MCP startup only — never written into this file, never passed into microsandboxes (§3.9). See docs/MCP_FRAMEWORK.md for rationale, install pattern, and credential isolation.

filesystem._purpose: Local read access for ledger, evidence manifest, case metadata. No write outside the working tree.

fetch._purpose: Threat-intel enrichment, MITRE ATT&CK live lookup, SANS docs retrieval. Cloud/dual mode only — egress audited via TSI.

sequential-thinking._purpose: Structured multi-step reasoning for the planner_critique_node CoVe pass. Reduces tool-call rounds without dropping rigor.

github._purpose: PR review, commit chain audit, BUILD_PLAN task ID correlation across the W#.#.# task surface. Token injected via env only.

mitre-attack._purpose: Technique lookup + sub-technique validation (CLAUDE.md §3.5 regex). Hypothesis MITRE mapping; negative-hypothesis deny-list checking.
